definition.best: minimum unrounded final LSS-accepted cost among the registered 30 runs
definition.hit: final cost exactly equals case Best, without decimal display rounding
definition.time: first certification/acceptance of returned solution in the internal CDF pool, measured from process launch; final original LSS acceptance subsequently verified
definition.mean: arithmetic mean over Best-hit runs only
definition.not_included: non-hit runs are excluded, not assigned zero or 600; time is not complete process duration or first final-LSS acceptance
